title: Character, World, Project & Event Integration / Reward Boundaries
objective: Define bounded deterministic typed reference/handoff contracts between MAL-local state and canonical Character/NPC, World/Scene, Project/progression and Action/Event owners plus explicit reward-boundary proposals over frozen MAL-01..07, without parallel owner truth, owner mutation or reward grants.

rules: MAL-08 consumes frozen MAL-01..07 contracts and explicit authorized typed references into canonical Character/NPC, World/Scene, Project/progression, Action/Event, Inventory/Asset, Combat, Travel, reward and Permission owners. It never creates parallel owner truth.

Owner references are reference-only. MAL-08 may carry stable owner identifiers, reference kind, visibility/provenance state and MAL-local proposal data, but may not copy hidden owner payloads or synthesize unavailable canonical state.
Unknown, hidden or unauthorized owner-domain state remains unresolved and is never inferred, defaulted to safe/available/completed or converted into a handoff.

MAL-local completion may prepare a typed proposal or handoff request only. It cannot mutate Character/NPC, World/Scene, Project/progression, Action/Event, Inventory/Asset, Combat, Travel, reward or Permission state.

Reward boundaries are explicit: MAL-08 may prepare a local reward request/reference, but cannot create, grant, transfer, equip, consume, award progression, change reputation, or authorize a reward. Canonical reward/Inventory/Project/progression/Permission owners decide.
Owner acknowledgements may be represented only when supplied as explicit authorized references; MAL-08 does not manufacture acknowledgement, success, failure or owner-domain consequences.

The same authorized references, MAL-local state and logical tick produce the same proposal/handoff state and deterministic receipt. Wall-clock, frame timing, device identity, network timing and nondeterministic randomness are excluded from outcome truth.
MAL-07 GCL reference integration remains frozen. MAL-08 does not expand unfinished GCL authority, discovery/recommendation, composition-engine behavior or hidden-library access.

AI remains proposal-only. It may draft typed local handoffs from visible authorized inputs but cannot invent hidden state, select secret outcomes, commit owner-domain results, grant rewards or bypass Permission.
forbidden: parallel Character/NPC, World/Scene, Project/progression, Action/Event, Inventory/Asset, Combat, Travel, reward or Permission truth
canonical owner mutation from MAL-local state
direct reward creation, grant, transfer, equip, consumption, progression, reputation or permission authorization
owner acknowledgement invention or hidden owner-state inference
AI owner-domain outcome commit or reward authority
copying proprietary integration logic, reward tables, event scripts, project/progression rules or owner payloads
GCL-13+ unfinished-content expansion, GCL discovery/recommendation or composition-engine implementation

invalidation_events: relevant AIOC MAL authority or checkpoint change
required validation reports a materially new failure signature

validation_requirement: Exactly one MAL-08 current-family profile, zero historical predecessor fanout, genuine matching self-hosted Linux/Windows acceptance RED before production mutation, then exact-head Linux/Windows GREEN and deterministic comparison.
